entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed, I really thought these would work out.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the new mountain bike cycling shoes. I took them out for one ride, just one, and they gave me horrible blisters on my heels. They just don't fit right at all.

Oh, that sounds incredibly uncomfortable. I understand why you'd want to return them. Just so I'm clear, is it a fit issue causing the blisters, or do you feel there's a technical fault with the shoe itself?

It's the fit. And I could never get the cleats to feel quite right either, they felt wobbly. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for so long, and I saved up for these. I just really need to get a refund if I can.

Of course. Let me just pull up your order. I see you received the shoes five days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund. I can absolutely process that for you right now.
Oh, you can? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

Not at all. We want you to be happy with your gear. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, apply the label, and you can drop them off at any carrier location.
That's wonderful. Thank you, Diana. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the return, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
